description: Queensland wastewater surveillance for SARS-CoV-2 is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Health. For more information on the wastewater surveillance program refer to the Queensland Health wastewater surveillance program results webpage: qld. gov. au/health/conditions/health-alerts/coronavirus-covid-19/current-status/wastewater or contact Queensland Health’s Water Unit at waterquality@health. au NOTE: This program closed on 30 September 2022 and this dataset is no longer updated. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Health. Its tags are COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2, sewage, surveillance, wastewater. It offers 8 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-10-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
